name: Colleton
gaps: Source query returned 9220 rows; 8615 stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the parcel-id and geometry checks.

Parcels are parcels (Colleton WebDataLayers) (https://services1.arcgis.com/m0cnLGKdhwao8WvM/arcgis/rest/services/WebDataLayers/FeatureServer/11). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
qPublic and Beacon property-appraiser links are stored as patterns and were not requested.
Owner phone and email are not ingested. SCDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.

No assessed/market/taxable value or sale price/date fields were present in the verified WebDataLayers/11 parcel schema; qPublic is available for interactive tax/sale lookup but no public REST was verified.
Current ColletonGIS WebDataStaticLayers has no parcels; do not use it as a parcel source.
Rejected wrong-geography search result: services.arcgis.com/KkJhFbLnXVqahKz2/Assessor_Parcels_Public1 sampled Santa Maria, California, not Colleton County SC.
Owner and address fields are public in WebDataLayers/11; normalize padded strings before use.
